en:
<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us...
But there's nothing displayed right now.

<CLT=cltMIND>How is anyone supposed to take a book off 
the shelf when they're crammed in like this?

<CLT=cltMIND>Books written in various languages
line this shelf...

<CLT=cltMIND>Some of these letters make no sense...
What languages are these supposed to be?

<CLT=cltMIND>These books seem difficult to read, and they're
not even written in a language I recognize...
<CLT=cltMIND>...Yeah, I'm not gonna bother with them.

<CLT=cltMIND>Looks like this ladder is for reaching books
on the higher shelves.

<CLT=cltMIND>I can't believe that door was hidden behind
this bookcase...

<CLT=cltMIND>We only found it because Shuichi could sense
something was off. That's pretty amazing...

<CLT=cltMIND>Huh? This globe is beautiful...
What's it doing here?

<CLT=cltMIND>Cramming this many books into a bookcase
is just going to damage them.
